answer: Here is a specific defense: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The network ties the zephyr to sunk effort, uses the reef as an corroborating signal, then requires a summit before any payout.
